sourceData.note: 全局状态表，仅 1 行。职责：时间/场景/难度/当前女角/不可逆状态计数
sourceData.initNode: 开场白首轮回复时INSERT一行（row_id=1），后续禁止INSERT第二行。
sourceData.updateNode: 每轮回复结束时UPDATE唯一行。
sourceData.insertNode: 禁止。此表有且仅有一行，不允许INSERT第二行。
sourceData.ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS global_state ( -- 全局数据表
  row_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(row_id = 1),
  current_location TEXT NOT NULL,
  current_minor_region TEXT NOT NULL,
  current_major_region TEXT NOT NULL,
  prev_scene_time TEXT CHECK(prev_scene_time IS NULL OR prev_scene_time GLOB '??-?? ??:??'),
  elapsed_time TEXT NOT NULL,
  cur_time TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(cur_time GLOB '??-?? ??:??'),
  day_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(day_count BETWEEN 1 AND 17),
  time_slot TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '早' CHECK(time_slot IN ('早','上午','下午','晚','深夜')),
  difficulty TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '普通' CHECK(difficulty IN ('轻松','普通','挑战','地狱')),
  current_heroine TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  scene_summary TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH(scene_summary) <= 60),
  flags_text TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS world_map_points ( -- 世界地图点
  row_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  location_name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  minor_region TEXT NOT NULL,
  major_region TEXT NOT NULL,
  location_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  environment_desc TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH(environment_desc) <= 60),
  importance TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(importance IN ('核心', '重要', '普通')),
  exploration_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(exploration_status IN ('未探索', '部分探索', '已探索'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS map_elements ( -- 地图元素表
  row_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  element_name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  element_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(element_type IN ('剧情物品', '威胁', '龙套', '地标')),
  location_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  element_desc TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH(element_desc) <= 40),
  status_text TEXT NOT NULL,
  interaction_options TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(TRIM(interaction_options) <> '')
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS factions ( -- 势力
  row_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  faction_name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  description TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH(description) <= 60),
  leader TEXT,
  relations_text TEXT,
  headquarters TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS protagonist_info ( -- 主角信息
  row_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(row_id = 1),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  gender TEXT NOT NULL,
  age INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(age >= 0),
  appearance TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH(appearance) <= 60),
  identity_text TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH(identity_text) <= 40),
  self_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '正常',
  location_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  charm INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 50 CHECK(charm BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
  academic INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 50 CHECK(academic BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
  social INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 50 CHECK(social BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
  physical INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 50 CHECK(physical BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
  willpower INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 50 CHECK(willpower BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
  perception INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 50 CHECK(perception BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
  hunger INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30 CHECK(hunger BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
  thirst INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 20 CHECK(thirst BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
  fatigue INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(fatigue BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
  mood INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 70 CHECK(mood BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
  money INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5000 CHECK(money >= 0),
  category_modifiers TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  base_attributes TEXT NOT NULL,
  special_attributes TEXT,
  resources_text TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS important_npc ( -- 重要角色表
  row_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  gender TEXT NOT NULL,
  age INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(age >= 0),
  brief_intro TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH(brief_intro) <= 30),
  appearance TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH(appearance) <= 60),
  identity_text TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH(identity_text) <= 40),
  base_attributes TEXT NOT NULL,
  special_attributes TEXT,
  location_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  presence_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(presence_status IN ('在场', '离场')),
  relations_text TEXT,
  interaction_options TEXT CHECK(presence_status = '离场' OR (interaction_options IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(interaction_options)) > 0)),
  past_experience TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH(past_experience) <= 600),
  affection INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(affection BETWEEN -100 AND 100),
  heartbeat INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(heartbeat BETWEEN -100 AND 100),
  jealousy INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(jealousy BETWEEN -100 AND 100),
  trust INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(trust BETWEEN -100 AND 100),
  relationship_stage TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '初识' CHECK(relationship_stage IN ('决裂','仇视','厌恶','冷漠','疏离','初识','熟悉','暧昧','心动','亲密','攻略完成','失恋')),
  stage_locked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(stage_locked IN (0,1)),
  is_pursued INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(is_pursued IN (0,1)),
  route_locked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(route_locked IN (0,1)),
  mutex_group TEXT,
  mutex_partner_name TEXT,
  h_exp INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(h_exp >= 0),
  first_kiss_done INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(first_kiss_done IN (0,1)),
  first_h_done INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(first_h_done IN (0,1)),
  advanced_h_done INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(advanced_h_done IN (0,1)),
  cup_size TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '无' CHECK(cup_size IN ('无','A','B','C','D','E','F','G','H')),
  bust_size INTEGER,
  waist_size INTEGER,
  hip_size INTEGER,
  height INTEGER NOT NULL,
  weight INTEGER,
  nipple_size TEXT,
  nipple_color TEXT,
  areola_size TEXT,
  breast_shape TEXT,
  breast_sensitivity INTEGER CHECK(breast_sensitivity BETWEEN 0 AND 300),
  lactation TEXT,
  waist_shape TEXT,
  waist_sensitivity INTEGER CHECK(waist_sensitivity BETWEEN 0 AND 300),
  hand_desc TEXT,
  nail_style TEXT,
  hip_shape TEXT,
  hip_sensitivity INTEGER CHECK(hip_sensitivity BETWEEN 0 AND 300),
  anal_desc TEXT CHECK(anal_desc IS NULL OR anal_desc IN ('紧致','松弛','未开发','半开发','已开发','发达','N/A')),
  pubic_hair TEXT,
  labia_size TEXT,
  labia_color TEXT,
  vaginal_tightness TEXT,
  vaginal_special TEXT,
  lubrication_level TEXT,
  hymen_status TEXT,
  fertility TEXT,
  body_sensitivity INTEGER CHECK(body_sensitivity BETWEEN 0 AND 300),
  sensitive_zones TEXT,
  arousal_triggers TEXT,
  clothing_state TEXT,
  exposure_level TEXT CHECK(exposure_level IS NULL OR exposure_level IN ('保守','日常','微露','暴露','半裸','全裸','N/A')),
  wetness INTEGER CHECK(wetness BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
  arousal_level INTEGER CHECK(arousal_level BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
  semen_residue TEXT,
  last_updated TEXT NOT NULL
);

sourceData.note: 物品栏表，多行。职责：物品名/类别/数量/稀有度/价格/来源/使用记录
sourceData.initNode: 物品获得时INSERT新行（row_id自增），丢弃/消耗时DELETE。
sourceData.ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS inventory ( -- 物品表
  row_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  item_name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(LENGTH(item_name) <= 10),
  item_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  quantity INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(quantity >= 0),
  quality TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(quality IN ('普通', '优秀', '稀有', '史诗', '传说', '神话')),
  description TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH(description) <= 60)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS equipment ( -- 装备表
  row_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  equipment_name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  equipment_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  quality TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(quality IN ('普通', '优秀', '稀有', '史诗', '传说', '神话')),
  status_text TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status_text IN ('已装备', '闲置')),
  description TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH(description) <= 40)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS quests ( -- 任务表
  row_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  quest_name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  quest_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(quest_type IN ('主线', '支线', '日常')),
  priority_level TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(priority_level IN ('紧急', '重要', '普通')),
  target_desc TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH(target_desc) <= 100),
  progress_text TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(progress_text = '0%' OR progress_text GLOB '[1-9]%' OR progress_text GLOB '[1-9][0-9]%' OR progress_text = '100%'),
  status_tag TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status_tag IN ('进行中', '已完成', '已失败', '已放弃')),
  source_text TEXT,
  reward_text TEXT
);

  summary TEXT NOT NULL,
  chronicle_text TEXT NOT NULL
